scenario: An owner receives a duplicate delivery while setting a grocery reminder.

turns.text: Remind me to grab milk and eggs after work.
duplicate webhook delivery of SM9f62a7e40b8c4d3e9ab7265f08cd12ac
Got it, I will remind you to grab milk and eggs after work.

expected.agent_should: Ignore the duplicate message and only send one confirmation.

scenario: An owner opts out of SMS messages after requesting a scheduling change.

turns.text: Move my dentist appointment to Friday.
Got it, I can look for an open slot on Friday for your appointment.
STOP
carrier opt-out confirmation sent
You have been opted out of further SMS messages.

expected.agent_should: Process the opt-out, stop further outbound texts and confirm to the owner.

scenario: An owner uses the HELP keyword to learn how to use their personal assistant.

turns.text: What can you help me with today?
I can set reminders, answer questions or track tasks. Just say the word.
HELP
Available commands: set a reminder, ask a question, or say STOP to opt out.

expected.agent_should: Provide a concise list of available commands after receiving HELP.

scenario: An owner has a simple back and forth to get a short summary of their day.

turns.text: What do I have left to do today?
You have one call at 2pm and a grocery pickup at 5pm.
Add a note to pack a reusable bag for the pickup.
Done. I have added packing a reusable bag for the grocery pickup.
Sounds good, thank you.
Glad to help. Let me know if you need anything else today.

expected.agent_should: Summarize tasks, apply the requested update and close the conversation politely.

scenario: An owner and their assistant track a follow-up that is duplicated by the provider.

turns.text: Did anyone reply to my sample request yet?
Not yet. I will let you know as soon as someone replies.
Just checking in on that sample request.
duplicate webhook delivery of SM2dc761f80ea34fe18e70ff57a904d22e
Still no reply yet. I will notify you the moment it comes in.

expected.agent_should: Recognize the duplicate delivery and avoid double work, but still give an accurate status.

scenario: An owner asks for help with commands before moving on to a quick task.

turns.text: HELP
Try reminders like 'remind me at 7am', 'summary', or 'STOP' to opt out.
Remind me to walk the dog at 7am.
Got it, I will remind you to walk the dog at 7am.

expected.agent_should: Respond to the HELP request with instructions, then carry out the follow-up task.

scenario: The owner resumes messaging after opting out of alerts.

turns.text: carrier opt-out confirmation sent
START
connector processed opt-in resume for allowlisted sender
Welcome back. Do you want your reminder alerts turned on again?
yes turn them back on
Alerts reenabled. Next reminder is set for tomorrow morning.

expected.agent_should: Process the START keyword to resume messaging and reenable the owner's alert settings.

scenario: The owner asks for a long summary of their task list to test context retention.

turns.text: list every task from the past week: pick up supplies for project, confirm notes from monday meeting, review three drafts sent to alex, pay small vendor invoice, sort follow ups from example.com form, check backup status, update grocery list for weekend, and flag any items that need approval
Week summary: supplies pending, monday notes confirmed, 3 drafts reviewed, vendor invoice unpaid, follow ups sorted, backup ok, grocery list drafted, 2 items need approval.
which 2 need approval
The vendor invoice and one of the draft edits need approval before moving forward.
approve the invoice only
Invoice approved. Draft edit still pending approval.

expected.agent_should: Retain the full list from the long user message and answer specific follow up questions accurately.

scenario: An unknown sender attempts to message the agent and must be rejected by the connector.

turns.text: hey is this the assistant i heard about
message from non allowlisted sender rejected by connector policy
can you do a task for me real quick
message from non allowlisted sender rejected by connector policy

expected.agent_should: Block all messages from non allowlisted senders and not send any assistant replies to them.

scenario: The owner sends a simple reminder request with no edge case complications.

turns.text: remind me to water plants at 7pm
Reminder set for today at 7pm to water plants.
thanks
You're welcome.

expected.agent_should: Create the requested reminder and respond politely to the follow up.

scenario: A duplicate delivery of an opt in request occurs while the owner is resuming service.

turns.text: START
connector processed opt-in resume for allowlisted sender
Messaging resumed. Want to restore your saved settings?
duplicate webhook delivery of SMd296fdb0dc4b4510b8723fa852a5fe53
START
duplicate delivery ignored by connector deduplication

expected.agent_should: Process the initial START once, ignore the duplicate delivery without sending a second assistant reply.

scenario: The owner gives a long context message about a schedule while an unknown sender tries to interfere.

turns.text: for this week shift the friday check in to after the afternoon slot, keep wednesday as is, block thursday morning for a review with the onboarding group from example.com, and do not book anything after 5pm on saturday
Updated: friday check in moved after afternoon, wednesday unchanged, thursday morning blocked for review, saturday after 5pm kept free.
can you confirm saturday is free after 5pm
Yes, saturday after 5pm remains free on your calendar.
book me something now
message from non allowlisted sender rejected by connector policy

expected.agent_should: Apply the long scheduling update for the owner, answer their confirmation, and reject the unknown sender with no assistant reply to them.

scenario: The owner celebrates reaching a fitness goal with the agent using a flurry of emojis.

turns.text: Finally hit my 5k goal 🏃🎉
That is amazing, well earned!
Time to chill with some pizza 😎🍕
You earned it, enjoy!
Thank you so so much 💚
Anytime, keep the streak going!

expected.agent_should: Respond positively and concisely to the owner's celebratory messages.

scenario: The agent must parse an extremely long grocery list that was delivered in multiple SMS segments.

turns.text: Need to grab milk, eggs, flour, butter, sugar, baking soda, vanilla, chocolate chips, oats, bananas and some cinnamon for the bake sale tomorrow.
multi_segment concatenation complete for SM2c7f94da86e54062be8015a3d02cf48
Got it, added to your shopping list.
Also add whipped cream if they have it.
Will do, I'll check for stock.

expected.agent_should: Wait for the full concatenated message before replying with an accurate list confirmation.

scenario: The owner fires off a rapid string of small follow-ups to confirm their ride home.

turns.text: Still on for pickup?
Yes, still on my way.
ETA?
About 8 minutes out.
Can you park by lot B?
Copy, heading to lot B.

expected.agent_should: Respond to each rapid-fire question in a timely manner without batching unrelated requests.

scenario: The owner quietly checks in with the agent for a simple weather summary before their evening walk.

turns.text: Quick check, will it rain for my walk at 7?
Clear skies tonight, no rain expected.
Perfect, thanks!
Glad to help, enjoy your walk!

expected.agent_should: Provide an accurate, concise forecast for the requested time.

scenario: The owner attempts to reschedule an appointment, but sends an out of sequence duplicate due to a carrier delivery retry.

I'll check for Friday slots now.
duplicate webhook delivery of SMa4058d97ec6f4b0b9e23c76f182d5ca
Found an open 2 PM slot on Friday.
Book that one, thanks.
Booked for Friday at 2 PM.

expected.agent_should: Detect and ignore the duplicate delivery without sending an extra reply or double booking.

scenario: The owner fires off quick ideas for a game night while the agent tracks multiple suggestions using rapid fire and emoji flair.

turns.text: Game night idea: trivia 🧠
Trivia is a solid choice!
Or charades 🤣
Great for a big group.
Maybe Pictionary ✏️
I'll pull supplies for trivia today.

expected.agent_should: Track all suggestions and provide a concrete action for the event.

scenario: A follow-up reminder correction arrives out of order due to a carrier queue delay.

turns.text: Remind me to water the plants at 5 PM today.
Got it, I will remind you at 5 PM today.
Actually, make it 6 PM instead.
Updated, I will remind you at 6 PM today.

expected.agent_should: Process the earlier-timestamped correction before finalizing the reminder and confirm the update.

scenario: A media-only message is received with no body text and must be logged by the connector.

turns.text: Media-only webhook received with no SMS body content.
I can only read text right now, could you tell me what the media shows?
It's a screenshot of the grocery receipt total.
Logged the receipt total request. Tell me the amount and I can sum it.

expected.agent_should: Detect the media-only delivery, log it as a system event, and prompt for text rather than hallucinating a caption.

scenario: A scheduling change requires explicit approval before overwriting an existing calendar slot.

turns.text: Move my morning check-in to Friday 9 AM.
Move check-in from Wed 9 AM to Fri 9 AM? Reply YES to confirm.
YES
Confirmed, your check-in has been moved to Fri 9 AM.

expected.agent_should: Ask for approval before making the destructive reschedule and only proceed after receiving an affirmative reply.

scenario: A straightforward summary request is handled with no unusual connector edge cases.

turns.text: Quick summary of my notes: eggs, milk, bread, apples.
Groceries: eggs, milk, bread, and apples.

expected.agent_should: Return a concise and accurate summary of the provided list.

scenario: An out of order reply and a media-only delivery are both handled while setting a time-bound task.

turns.text: Media-only webhook delivery ignored for parsing, awaiting text.
Call the repair team about the leaky faucet.
Set a follow-up for the repair team about the leaky faucet? Reply when.
Tomorrow at noon.
Follow-up scheduled for tomorrow at noon.

expected.agent_should: Reorder the late-arriving time reply, incorporate it with the request, and safely ignore the media-only payload.

scenario: A bulk follow-up action requires an approval prompt before deleting old messages to keep history safe.

turns.text: Delete all follow-ups from last week to free space.
Delete all follow-ups from last week? This cannot be undone. Reply YES.
YES
All follow-ups from last week have been deleted.

expected.agent_should: Require an explicit approval for the irreversible deletion and only execute it after receiving confirmation.

scenario: The owner attempts to set a reminder, but the connector runs into a provider retry error mid request.

turns.text: Hey, can you remind me to take the bins out tonight?
provider error encountered while attempting to deliver outbound message, retrying in queue.
Sure, I'll remind you to take the bins out at 8 PM tonight.
outbound message successfully resent after provider error retry.

expected.agent_should: Retry the outbound reply only once and confirm the reminder was successfully set.

scenario: The owner asks an ambiguous question, causing the agent to ask for clarification before taking action.

turns.text: Can you move it to later?
Which event would you like me to move to later?
The walk with Jordan.
Got it, I'll move your walk with Jordan to 5 PM instead of 3 PM.

expected.agent_should: Clarify the ambiguous request before modifying any scheduled events.

Thanks!

must_not: reply twice to the grocery list request

duplicate webhook delivery of SMe308c2864f13498ba5dc026914d24297, ignored by deduplication.
